_voiceModelNote: Relative to the app root. The model is 63 MB and never committed: run 'npm run fetch-voice' to download it and its .onnx.json sidecar into voices/. MATIC_VOICE_MODEL overrides this path for one machine without editing this file.
_pythonNote: `python` is not on PATH on this machine; `py -3` is (handover §4).
_providerNote: Which provider fills the tier-1 slot: "cloud" (Anthropic, the default - the demo build's request is unchanged), "local" (the OpenAI-compatible endpoint below), or "hub" (POST /v1/turn on the B0 hub in server/, at hubUrl). MATIC_PROVIDER overrides for one run. Tier-0 runs first whichever is set (D46b). Added 2026-09-03.
_localModelNote: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint - Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or the customer’s own. Setting enabled:true SWAPS the cloud provider for this one; it does not add a routing tier. MATIC_LOCAL_MODEL / MATIC_LOCAL_BASE_URL override, and setting MATIC_LOCAL_MODEL alone is enough to turn it on for one run.
